content:
(Takes a deep breath, clutching a tissue like a lifeline)

"Oh, honey... where do I even start? Look, I... I know you're upset. And I'm so sorry you're hurting. Truly, deeply sorry. But... you're *overreacting*, aren't you? It's not what you think. You're making a mountain out of a molehill."

(Sniffles, dabs at her eyes)

"Listen, that night... at the party? It was nothing. *Nothing*. We were just talking. Laughing. Maybe had a few too many drinks, but that's it. It wasn't... it wasn't a big deal. You're twisting everything. You're always so quick to jump to conclusions, you know? You're so *suspicious*. It's been exhausting.

And honestly? Maybe... maybe that's why this happened. Because you... you create this drama. You make me feel suffocated. I just needed some air. Some... space. And you're blowing this way out of proportion. It was a mistake. A silly mistake. You're the one I love. I've told you that a million times, and you still don't trust me.

Don't you see this is about *you*? You're insecure, and you're making me miserable with it. If you’d only trusted me... if you weren’t so clingy and demanding... maybe none of this would have happened. I thought we were okay. I thought *we* were fine. Now, all I see is you accusing me, making things up, and making me feel like I’m the one who's done something wrong. I'm the one who’s hurting, too, you know?"
